description.en-US: Choose whether Amadeus asks for execution approval in Work and Cooperative chats. Permission limits and external tool gates still apply.
description.zh-CN: 选择 Amadeus 是否在 Work 与协作聊天中请求执行审批；权限限制和外部工具自身门禁仍然有效。

title.en-US: Automatically approve Work and Chat requests
title.zh-CN: 自动批准 Work 与聊天请求

description.en-US: Automatically approve permitted requests in all Work and Cooperative chats, including MCP and shell. Deny policies and read-only limits still apply. Saved across restarts until you turn it off; approvals remain recorded.
description.zh-CN: 自动批准所有 Work 与协作聊天中可授权的请求，包括 MCP 和 Shell。拒绝策略与只读限制仍然有效。跨重启保存，直到手动关闭；审批仍会留痕。
